Stardate plays Simon & Schuster's *Star Trek* interactive fiction for the IBM PC, as it was: *The Kobayashi Alternative*, *The Promethean Prophecy* and *First Contact*, which are included by permission of their copyright holders.

## Playing

Download the file for your computer, unpack it, and run `stardate` in the folder (`stardate.exe` on Windows). With no game named, a menu lists the games: pick one with the arrow keys and Enter. From a terminal, a game's short name starts it at once: `stka`, `stpp` or `stfc`. `stardate --help` lists the rest.

| Download | For |
|---|---|
| `win-x64` (zip) | Windows, 64-bit |
| `linux-x64` (tar.gz) | Linux, 64-bit |
| `osx-arm64` (tar.gz) | macOS on Apple silicon |
| `osx-x64` (tar.gz) | macOS on Intel |

The programs aren't signed. Windows may ask before running one from the internet (More info, then Run anyway). macOS keeps it from opening until it's allowed: in the unpacked folder, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine .` in a terminal, or allow it in System Settings, Privacy & Security.

Saves and settings go in a `Stardate` folder in your user's application data; the games' own files are never changed.
